en_summary: @StockSavvyShay posts that $ASTS just broke below $40, with a screenshot showing $39.86, down $2.00 (4.79%) on the day. In the quoted post she said she has been adding to her $ASTS position during the drawdown because rising yields do not change how early the build-out of a larger space economy is, with satellites becoming another layer of global telecom infrastructure. text:
It is true that china banned facebook and google etc earlier so maybe it's a tit for tat by america instead. 

But then. We have a car industry domestically and now some exports because we have applied tariffs on car imports (not banned them). We do design services for all semiconductor companies but we don't make them here, and indeed even buy heavy engineering stuff like tunnel borers from China.
